body_html:
I didn't expect #flyers to go deep this year. I hope but do not expect but to see another game without Couturier just reminds me of last year's first round ejection.

3-1. Can we do this? We have done it 3-0 against Bruins. ...Need Couturier or we might as well just give away the PP goals.
